answer: The inlet escrow is released only against a copper receipt, and the opal audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 6 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 77 aliases means carrying 108 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. The fee repeats 18 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
